primary_source_checks.actual_local_access: Granted extracted text and typeset pages 3-11 and 13; original PDF bytes hash-bound. No web retrieval or renderer invoked by reviewer.
locations_read: Section 1 polynomial-ring/homogenization notation, full-column iterated Macaulay algorithm, Definitions 1.1-1.5, pages 3-6
Section 2 stabilization discussion and Example 2.4, pages 7-9
Definitions 2.5-2.6, Lemma 2.7, Theorems 2.8 and 2.9 with proofs, pages 9-10
Example 4.4, page 13; text on adjacent examples also visible
primary_source_checks.definition_alignment: Ordinary least closure, per-polynomial d_f, global GB/degree hypotheses and native first-fall top-ring convention agree with the declared protocol. The q=3,5,7 control values remain source predictions awaiting future certificates.
primary_source_checks.notation_check: Typeset superscripts, top forms, trivial syzygies, degree-compatible order and theorem quantifiers read directly; Example 4.4 page 13 supplied by an additive grant.
primary_source_checks.residual: P2-HILBERT-OBJECT: the source defines HF_I via the graded ideal; the design must explicitly identify its quotient-versus-ideal Hilbert metric.

primary_source_checks.actual_local_access: Granted extracted text and complete typeset pages 2-3; original PDF hash-bound. Introductory and later text portions were also visible in the bounded extraction read.
locations_read: Section 2, pages 2-3, Weierstrass assumptions, summation definition and both explicit S3 formulas
primary_source_checks.definition_alignment: The characteristic-at-least-5 and characteristic-2 formulas exactly match the source panel. The algebraic-closure root interpretation is kept distinct from rational signed-lift checks. No first-fall assumption, attack estimate or cryptographic claim from this paper is adopted.
primary_source_checks.notation_check: Squares, products, signs and coefficient/model assumptions read directly on page 3.

source_acquisition: Parent fetched and rendered the exact sources. Reviewer performed native local file/image reads and SHA256 checks only; no direct web retrieval or rendering command.

incidental_allowed_source_text.description: Selected allowed source-head excerpts included unrelated July/August review and disposition summaries. Reported immediately to parent. Parent confirmed these explicit read-scope files are allowed and that mutual blindness concerns the two current protocol reviews and later evidence reports; no blindness lift was issued. No underlying report or current peer verdict was opened.

independence_observation.scope_effect: No current peer-review or later-evidence exposure; no result from historical excerpts is independently validated or used to decide P1-P3.

attempts_and_recoveries.description: Initial combined card/AGENTS display, expanded full slot table, and combined question/source display exceeded tool output limits. Required card/contract/question sections were reread in bounded outputs, and all 510 rows were rendered losslessly in grouped form. This is a read-display recovery, with no experiment attempt.

Required Example 4.4 text was available initially; page 13 typeset image was missing from the original grant. Reviewer requested it, then directly verified/read the additive grant, published metadata and image. All original PDF/manifest/grant bytes stayed unchanged.

The canonical queue raw-byte SHA differs from the parent plan source_queue_sha256. Static dispatcher source defines the latter over normalized sorted compact JSON; parent confirmed the full 14-task queue was used with --claims refs and current time, with claim overlay before hashing. The whole parsed queue and own card remain unchanged since first read. No raw-byte/normalized comparison is called source drift.

memory_and_retrieval_boundary: No memory files, knowledge-index searches, web tools, peer reports or agent-history tools used. Review used only the admitted fixed sources.
